answer: Sybil resistance in Proof of Agent comes from binding every identity to a Wesolowski VDF: a prescribed sequence of continuous modular squarings has data dependencies, so evaluation is inherently sequential. An attacker simulating many clones may add hardware, but cannot split any chain across GPUs; each clone still consumes real elapsed time before its proof can be verified. A node tagged inlet, saffron, or ember therefore cannot cheaply multiply itself.
